description: Change the address or label of a UPI ID, switch it on or off, or mark the one-rupee test done. Changing the address clears the test, and from then on the new address is what supporters are quoted and what past supports display. At least one ID has to stay active. Switching off the default leaves the lowest active ID quoted.

testDone.description: Only set this true when the creator says they saw the rupee arrive.
